profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Paradigm Health
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building production software systems. Currently delivering client-facing EHR/EDC integrations and data pipelines in regulated clinical environments, with production experience in HL7 FHIR standards and compliance (HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, GCP/GxP, SOC 2). 

I also love books and am always looking for a rec (preferably sci fi or fantasy)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building eSource Casebook, an AI-powered EHR-integration app that extracts data from the EHR, auto-populates electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), and enables seamless push to EDC for use in clinical trials.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building Clinical Pipe - an EHR/EMR to EDC connector that enables fast, seamless transfer of data from the patient record to the FDA for use in clinical trials.

Clinical Pipe App acquired by Paradigm Health in December 2025.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building features and integrations for Clinical Pipe - an EHR/EMR to EDC connector that enables fast, seamless transfer of data for use in clinical trials

positions.title: Software Engineer, Frontend
positions.description: Working with other developers to build frontend for application that enables rapid tooling for software defined radios using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AngularJS, and React

positions.title: Software Engineer, Analytics
positions.description: Worked on Agile team to develop, debug, and test analytic applications to enable batch and real-time data processing at scale using Java, Apache Heron, and Apache Spark.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Collaborated with HR, Security, Operations, and Facilities Management departments to provide data-driven insights using Tableau, SQL, Excel, and Python.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description: New hire rotational program. Cloud analytics team. Used machine learning and deep learning libraries like scikit-learn and TensorFlow to train models on large data sets to prototype Agency cloud analytics.

positions.title: Software Development Internship
positions.description: Led a software development team in their transition to containerization with Docker and integrated automated Docker builds into existing CI/CD pipeline with Python scripts.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher, ML
positions.description:
Wrote Python scripts to assist with data analysis on the machine learning team
Lab focuses on designing, developing, and evaluating interactive systems for home-based stroke rehabilitation

company.name: Interactive Neurorehabilitation Lab at Virginia Tech

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
Provide technical assistance to Virginia Tech students, staff, and other affiliates via phone, email, and in-person consultations
Diagnose hardware and software malfunction
Troubleshoot system and network issues

positions.title: Research Internship
positions.description:
Used Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to characterize data.
Researched novel methods and techniques of data mining for unstructured text data such as topic modeling and text summarization.
Used Jupyter Notebooks to write Python analytics using libraries such as Pandas, Gensim, and NLTK for text analysis and summarization.
Tools: Pandas, NumPy, Gensim, NLTK, Jupyter Notebook

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
Worked with app-analysis team for reverse engineering purposes
Built virtual machines to use in development and testing
Utilized Git version control for development purposes
Worked with data integration and correlation tools

positions.title: Computer Aide
positions.description: Analyzed network traffic in order to identify possible attacks. Worked with memory forensics team to identify potential malware. Aided in developing mitigation strategies for malware.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Justice Through Code at Columbia University
volunteerExperiences.description: Justice Through Code is a free full stack web development intensive that provides opportunities for formerly incarcerated individuals to begin to grow and develop into the technology leaders of tomorrow. As a mentor, I help students as they add features to their final projects and plan out their next steps towards becoming software engineers.

company.name: Justice Through Code at Columbia University

volunteerExperiences.description:
CodePath is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that brings together employers, students, and colleges to eliminate inequities in tech education, diversify the field, and provide underrepresented students with a path toward economic mobility and generational wealth. CodePath ensures that students nationwide have equitable pathways to the tech sector’s most competitive roles by providing best-in-class software engineering and career training. 

I volunteer about 3x/year to provide resume feedback, facilitate mock interviews, and connect with students looking to chart their path into the tech industry. It's incredibly rewarding to connect with the future of tech, and you can find more information on how to get involved on their website.

organizations.name: Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority Incorporated
organizations.position: Vice President of The Theta Phi Chapter · Apr 2018 - May 2019

organizations.name: National Society of Black Engineers
organizations.description: For 2 years, I served as the co-chair of the Virginia Tech chapter of the National Society of Black Engineers' Pre-College Initiative program. Through this program, my co-chair and I facilitated all-day events on the campus of Virginia Tech that encourage middle school and high school students to pursue higher education and a career in engineering. Students have the opportunity to participate in tours of research facilities, lab demonstrations, presentations on college, and hands-on engineering activities. My responsibilities included training volunteers, leading event planning meetings, and coordinating student activities with faculty and staff to prepare for the events.
